parsed_output.overall_summary: This video provides a tutorial on how to improve a 'weak' overhead press by focusing on three key form adjustments. The creator, @tylerpath, first demonstrates common mistakes before explaining how to maintain a neutral and stacked wrist and elbow joint for optimal force transfer and injury prevention. He then advises pushing the head 'through the hole' at the top of the press to enhance balance. Finally, the video emphasizes the importance of squeezing the glutes and bracing the core to create a stable, singular unit for a more effective and powerful press.

takeaways.statement: To improve your overhead press, ensure your wrist is neutral and your elbow and wrist joints are stacked by your forearm for optimal force transfer and to prevent injury.
When performing an overhead press, push your head 'into the hole' at full extension to maintain a better center of balance.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core to create a singular, stable unit with your body, allowing for a more effective overhead press from a stable platform.
